title: From the top 10 port binding hosts with the highest variance in port standa
question: From the top 10 port binding hosts with the highest variance in port standard attribute ID (considering only ports with status 'DOWN' that have an IP allocation), display each host name and its variance, along with the port status, device owner, number of distinct security-group-bound ports, and the minimum standard attribute ID for 'DOWN' ports by device owner. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT pbb.host, p.device_owner, p.status, p.standard_attr_id, p.id AS port_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN portbindingports pbb ON pbb.port_id = p.id
  JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
),
host_var AS (
  SELECT host,
         (SUM(standard_attr_id*standard_attr_id) - SUM(standard_attr_id)*SUM(standard_attr_id)/COUNT(*)) / COUNT(*) AS variance
  FROM base
  GROUP BY host
  ORDER BY variance DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
sg AS (
  SELECT pbb.host, COUNT(DISTINCT sgp.port_id) AS sg_ports
  FROM base b
  JOIN portbindingports pbb ON pbb.port_id = b.port_id
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgp ON sgp.port_id = b.port_id
  GROUP BY pbb.host
),
minstd AS (
  SELECT p.device_owner, MIN(p.standard_attr_id) AS min_std
  FROM ports p
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
  GROUP BY p.device_owner
)
SELECT hv.host,
       hv.variance,
       b.status,
       b.device_owner,
       COALESCE(sg.sg_ports,0) AS sg_ports,
       ms.min_std
FROM host_var hv
JOIN base b ON b.host = hv.host
LEFT JOIN sg ON sg.host = hv.host
LEFT JOIN minstd ms ON ms.device_owner = b.device_owner
ORDER BY hv.variance DESC
LIMIT 10
